candidate_workaround: Discover exact generated artifact paths and fields, synchronize the test module, and replay all tests from a fresh invocation.
failure_signature: The first current-phase unit-test replay produced three path or field errors from assumed generated schemas.
recurrence_guard: Tests bind generated artifact names and fields only after positive-cardinality discovery and targeted schema inspection.
rollback: Give the six-pass three-error run zero suite credit and leave the evidence candidate uncommitted.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded test-schema recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Bind current-phase tests to generated evidence schemas
trigger_preconditions: a new test module consumes generated phase artifacts
artifact names or fields are schema-specific
